English reference: Custom font for item icon texts
Simplified Chinese: 自定义物品图标文字字体

English reference: Item level, stack count, binding, etc. Unchecked: Baganator's original look. The size is multiplied by Baganator's icon text size (14 = x1).
Simplified Chinese: 物品等级、堆叠数量、绑定状态等。取消勾选时使用 Baganator 原始样式。字号会乘以 Baganator 的图标文字缩放（14 = 1 倍）。

English reference: Custom font for buff and debuff timers
Simplified Chinese: 自定义增益与减益计时字体

English reference: Unchecked: Platynator's original look. The size is multiplied by the text scale set in Platynator.
Simplified Chinese: 取消勾选时使用 Platynator 原始样式。字号会乘以 Platynator 设置的文字缩放。

English reference: Unchecked: Platynator's original look. The size is multiplied by the text scale set in Platynator.
Simplified Chinese: 取消勾选时使用 Platynator 原始样式。字号会乘以 Platynator 设置的文字缩放。

English reference: disabled: the %s skin of Baganator already sets these fonts
Simplified Chinese: 已禁用：Baganator 的 %s 皮肤已接管这些字体

English reference: Right-click the AishCore minimap icon to open the settings panel.
Simplified Chinese: 右键 AishCore 小地图图标可打开设置面板。

English reference: You can move most AishCore frames from the settings panel.
Simplified Chinese: 大多数 AishCore 框架可在设置面板中移动。

English reference: Skyriding automatically hides several HUD elements while flying.
Simplified Chinese: 驭空飞行时会自动隐藏多个界面元素。

English reference: The Cooldown Manager can be recolored per state from the settings.
Simplified Chinese: 可在设置中为冷却管理器的不同状态设定颜色。

English reference: Auras can be sorted into icons, bars, or circle trackers independently.
Simplified Chinese: 光环可分别归入图标、条形或圆环追踪器。

English reference: Priority Bar highlights your next recommended ability.
Simplified Chinese: 优先技能条会高亮下一个推荐技能。

English reference: You can preview this AFK screen anytime from the settings panel.
Simplified Chinese: 可随时在设置面板预览待机画面。

English reference: Guild and whispers keep showing up on screen while you're away.
Simplified Chinese: 离开时仍会在画面中显示公会消息与密语。

English reference: Mirrored bars on either side of the resource circle. Ideal for continuous active buffs. You pick the spells to display from "Tracked Auras".
Simplified Chinese: 资源圆环两侧的镜像进度条，适合持续生效的增益。在“已追踪光环”中选择要显示的技能。

English reference: Mirrored bars around the resource circle. You pick the spells from Tracked Auras.
Simplified Chinese: 资源圆环周围的镜像进度条。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: The bar shown when you cast a spell with a cast time. Position, size and font style.
Simplified Chinese: 施放需要读条的技能时显示的施法条。可设置位置、大小和字体样式。

English reference: The addon's global color palette. Customize the gold, accent, background and class color tints.
Simplified Chinese: 插件的全局配色。可自定义金色、强调色、背景和职业颜色。

English reference: Freely positionable bars (wide side). Ideal for cooldowns and long-duration effects. You pick the spells to display from "Tracked Auras".
Simplified Chinese: 可自由放置的宽进度条，适合冷却和长时间效果。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: Freely positionable bars. You pick the spells from Tracked Auras.
Simplified Chinese: 可自由放置的进度条。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: A row of icons (aegis style) with a duration bar. Ideal for DoTs and auras on the target. You pick the spells to display from "Tracked Auras".
Simplified Chinese: 带持续时间条的一排图标（盾形样式），适合目标身上的持续伤害和光环。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: A row of icons with a duration bar. You pick the spells from Tracked Auras.
Simplified Chinese: 带持续时间条的一排图标。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: 3D animations that play on your auras (icon, bar, spark) on a proc, a cast or a combat event. The inner menu lets you configure each view (icon / bar / spark) per spell.
Simplified Chinese: 在触发、施法或战斗事件发生时，在光环图标、进度条或端点上播放的 3D 动画。子菜单可逐技能配置图标、进度条和端点视图。

English reference: 3D animations that loop around your Recovery Circle (out of combat). They disappear as soon as you enter combat.
Simplified Chinese: 脱战时在恢复圆环周围循环播放的 3D 动画，进入战斗后立即消失。

English reference: 3D animations that play on the resource circle when you cast a spell.
Simplified Chinese: 施法时在资源圆环上播放的 3D 动画。

English reference: 3D effects on secondary resources: combo points (Rogue, Feral), runes (DK), chi (Monk), Holy Power (Paladin), essences (Evoker), etc.
Simplified Chinese: 次要资源的 3D 效果：连击点（潜行者、野性德鲁伊）、符文（死亡骑士）、真气（武僧）、圣能（圣骑士）、精华（唤魔师）等。

English reference: The recovery circle that only appears out of combat. Used for healing, food and regeneration buffs.
Simplified Chinese: 仅脱战时出现的恢复圆环，用于治疗、食物及恢复类增益。

English reference: Alerts you when a group buff you can provide (Arcane Intellect, Battle Shout...) is missing on yourself or a group/raid member. Also covers stances/auras/attunements, pets and poisons.
Simplified Chinese: 当自己或队伍／团队成员缺少你能提供的团队增益（奥术智慧、战斗怒吼等）时提醒；也支持姿态、光环、调谐、宠物和毒药。

English reference: Enables an in-game preview mode that simulates fake auras in each slot so you can see the render without waiting for real combat.
Simplified Chinese: 启用游戏内预览，在各栏位模拟光环，无需等待实际战斗即可查看效果。

English reference: Two groups of slots on either side of the resource circle. Each slot automatically displays the highest-priority available spell in its list.
Simplified Chinese: 资源圆环两侧的两组栏位。每个栏位自动显示其列表中当前可用且优先级最高的技能。

English reference: 2 groups of slots on either side of the resource circle. Each slot automatically displays the highest-priority available spell in its list.
Simplified Chinese: 资源圆环两侧的两组栏位。每个栏位自动显示其列表中当前可用且优先级最高的技能。

English reference: Compact icons in a grid or row. Ideal for procs and short effects. You pick the spells to display from "Tracked Auras".
Simplified Chinese: 以网格或单行排列的紧凑图标，适合触发和短时效果。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: Compact icons. You pick the spells from Tracked Auras.
Simplified Chinese: 紧凑图标。在“已追踪光环”中选择技能。

English reference: Save, load or share your configs between characters. A profile = the whole setup (positions, colors, tracked spells).
Simplified Chinese: 保存、加载或跨角色分享配置。一个配置包含整套设置：位置、颜色和追踪技能。

English reference: The main circle around your character that displays your resource (mana, rage, energy...). Two modes: one in combat and one out of combat.
Simplified Chinese: 角色周围的主圆环，显示法力、怒气、能量等资源，提供战斗与脱战两种模式。

English reference: The indicator that suggests your next spell to cast based on your spec and resources.
Simplified Chinese: 根据专精和资源提示下一个建议施放技能的指示器。

English reference: Specific display when dragonriding: speed, vigor and altitude indicators.
Simplified Chinese: 驭龙时的专用显示：速度、精力和高度指示器。

English reference: The central list of all spells the addon watches. Add spells here then assign them to a slot (Icon List, Free Bars, Icons...).
Simplified Chinese: 插件监视的全部技能总表。在此添加技能，再将其分配到图标列表、自由进度条或图标等栏位。

English reference: The bar that shows what your target is casting. Handy for interrupting at the right time.
Simplified Chinese: 显示目标正在施放的技能，便于把握打断时机。

English reference: The health bar and visible auras on your current target. Configure the main bar and the auras separately in the tabs.
Simplified Chinese: 当前目标的血条与光环。在不同页签中分别配置主血条与光环。

English reference: Manage your trinkets and racials on cooldown. Configuration per equipment slot.
Simplified Chinese: 管理饰品和种族技能的冷却，可按装备栏位配置。

English reference: Trinkets and racials. Configuration per slot from this menu.
Simplified Chinese: 饰品与种族技能，可在此菜单按栏位配置。

English reference: The main health and resource bars of your character. Configure their size, position, texture and colors here.
Simplified Chinese: 角色的主要生命条与资源条，可设置大小、位置、材质和颜色。

English reference: The custom experience bar that replaces the Blizzard bar. Displays XP, reputation and honor depending on context.
Simplified Chinese: 替代暴雪经验条的自定义进度条，可根据情境显示经验、声望或荣誉。

English reference:
This section will be available
once AishCore is integrated into AishUI.
Simplified Chinese: 此部分将在 AishCore 整合进 AishUI 后开放。
根据追踪策略与装备自动设置

English reference:
No layer.
Click + to add a 3D effect.
Simplified Chinese:
没有图层。
点击 + 添加 3D 特效。
未检测到物品（请装备饰品后输入 /reload）
布局（饰品／种族技能／装备）

English reference: LibSerialize or LibDeflate missing — export/import disabled
Simplified Chinese: 缺少 LibSerialize 或 LibDeflate，导入／导出已禁用

English reference: %d spell(s) configured. Go to Tactics to see them.
Simplified Chinese: 已配置 %d 个技能，请到追踪策略中查看。

English reference: %d spell(s) configured, %d not found (play them once then reapply).
Simplified Chinese: 已配置 %d 个技能，未找到 %d 个（请先使用一次，再重新应用）。
已应用预设“%s”（%d 个技能）

English reference: Applies a recommended configuration to spells already discovered by the Cooldown Manager.
Simplified Chinese: 对冷却管理器已经发现的技能应用推荐配置。

English reference:
No preset available for your current specialization.
Come back when you're playing a spec covered by the collection.
Simplified Chinese:
当前专精暂无预设。
使用预设集已支持的专精时再来查看。
使用 3D 时的进度条不透明度
背景不透明度（0 为透明）

English reference: Customize the color or gradient per spell
Simplified Chinese: 为每个技能自定义颜色或渐变

English reference: This uses Blizzard's native cooldown counter -- font size and color below can't be customized here.
Simplified Chinese: 此处使用暴雪原生冷却计时，无法在下方自定义其字号与颜色。

English reference: Shared glow for this display mode, for spells that follow the default glow. A spell whose glow was customized in "Auras to track" keeps its own settings, which take priority.
Simplified Chinese: 此显示模式的共用发光，适用于采用默认发光的技能。在“需要追踪的光环”中单独设置过发光的技能，会优先使用其自身设置。

English reference: Overrides the glow of all spells in this render
Simplified Chinese: 覆盖此视图中所有技能的发光
使用各技能的发光颜色

English reference: Moves the bar to the other side of the icon. It always keeps emptying toward the icon.
Simplified Chinese: 将进度条移到图标另一侧，仍始终朝图标方向耗尽。
在图标上显示持续时间
管理模式已开启，输入 /aishadmin 退出

English reference:
Left click: pick a color.
Right click: reset to the active spec's "Glow" color.
Simplified Chinese:
左键：选择颜色。
右键：重置为当前专精的“发光”颜色。

English reference: Automatically applied to any checked aura that has no custom glow set (manual setting in the list below). Without a color chosen here, follows the active spec's "Glow" color (Colors module).
Simplified Chinese: 自动应用于已勾选且未单独设置发光的光环（可在下方列表手动设置）。此处未指定颜色时，跟随颜色模块中当前专精的“发光”颜色。

English reference: Remove this spell from the list (undoable while admin mode is on)
Simplified Chinese: 从列表移除此技能（管理模式开启时可撤销）
已发现的光环（冷却管理器）

English reference: [L] Icon List  [C] Circle Bars  [I] Icons  [B] Free Bars
Simplified Chinese: [L] 图标列表  [C] 环形条  [I] 图标  [B] 自由条

English reference: Left click: next category (Debuff -> Buff -> Totem -> Debuff...)
Simplified Chinese: 左键：下一类别（减益 → 增益 → 图腾 → 减益……）

English reference: Aura tooltip in combat only with ALT  |cff888888(independent from Priority Bar)|r
Simplified Chinese: 战斗中仅按住 ALT 时显示光环提示  |cff888888（与优先级提示条无关）|r

English reference: Use native CDM  |cff888888(disables all our custom bars/icons)|r
Simplified Chinese: 使用原生冷却管理器  |cff888888（禁用我们的所有自定义进度条／图标）|r

English reference: This spec has no active build yet: a build is created from the current Cooldown Manager, then your change is applied to it.
Simplified Chinese: 此专精尚无启用方案：将根据当前冷却布局创建方案，再应用本次更改。

English reference: Choose which cooldowns the Cooldown Manager tracks for this spec (spells, trinkets, potions), and whether they go to Essential or Utility. Each spec can have several named builds, saved in your profile and shared with it. These setups are independent from tracked buffs, which are set in "Auras to Track".
Simplified Chinese: 选择此专精由冷却管理器追踪的技能、饰品和药水，并将其归入核心或功能分组。每个专精可保存多个命名方案，随配置一起保存和分享。需要追踪的增益在“需要追踪的光环”中单独设置。
核心技能排列顺序不同

English reference: Differences between the profile and the Cooldown Manager
Simplified Chinese: 配置方案与当前冷却布局的差异

English reference: Cannot change the Cooldown Manager in combat.
Simplified Chinese: 战斗中无法更改冷却管理器。

English reference: No Cooldown Manager setup for this spec in the profile.
Simplified Chinese: 当前配置没有此专精的冷却布局方案。

English reference: The Cooldown Manager refused some changes: %s
Simplified Chinese: 冷却管理器拒绝了部分更改：%s
冷却管理器暂不可用（尚未加载）。

English reference: The original build stays untouched, so you can always go back to it.
Simplified Chinese: 原方案保持不变，便于随时切回。

English reference:
Your AishCore profile uses the build "%s" for this spec, but the Cooldown Manager does not match it.

Apply it now? The interface will reload.
Simplified Chinese:
此专精的 AishCore 配置使用“%s”方案，但当前冷却管理器布局与其不一致。

是否立即应用？界面将重新加载。
将当前冷却布局另存为…

English reference: Creates a build from the Cooldown Manager as it is now (or replaces the build with the same name), then makes it active.
Simplified Chinese: 根据当前冷却布局创建方案（或覆盖同名方案），并将其设为启用状态。

English reference: No active build: this spec is not managed (showing the current Cooldown Manager)
Simplified Chinese: 无启用方案：此专精暂不受管理（显示当前冷却布局）
更改尚未应用（需要重载界面）

English reference: Not applied (identical to the current Cooldown Manager)
Simplified Chinese: 尚未应用（与当前冷却布局相同）

English reference: %d aura(s) were pinned to the native Cooldown Manager (Bars). Reload the UI now to apply the change safely?
Simplified Chinese: 已将 %d 个光环固定到原生冷却管理器（进度条）。是否立即重载界面以安全应用？

English reference:
AishUI has applied its settings (EllesmereUI modules, Platynator and ElvUI profiles, Edit Mode layout).

Reload the UI now to apply them.
Simplified Chinese:
AishUI 已应用设置（EllesmereUI 模块、Platynator 与 ElvUI 配置、编辑模式布局）。

请立即重载界面以应用。

English reference: Shows the "Recently Bandaged" debuff duration on bandages.
Simplified Chinese: 在绷带上显示“最近使用过绷带”减益的持续时间。

English reference: Items never shown on this bar. Type an item ID or drag an item from your bags into the field.
Simplified Chinese: 此动作条永不显示的物品。输入物品 ID，或将背包物品拖入输入框。
动态动作条：未知的物品 ID。

English reference: Click to remove from the blacklist

Simplified Chinese: 动态动作条：设置已复制。

English reference: Copies layout, visibility, icons and texts. Items shown, position and on/off are kept.
Simplified Chinese: 复制布局、显示条件、图标与文字设置。保留显示物品、位置与开关状态。

English reference: Zooms the icon slightly to hide Blizzard's built-in border.
Simplified Chinese: 略微放大图标，以隐藏暴雪自带的边框。

English reference: Bind keys in Game Menu > Options > Keybindings > AddOns > "AishCore - Dynamic Bars" (12 buttons per bar).
Simplified Chinese: 在游戏菜单 > 选项 > 按键设置 > 插件 >“AishCore - Dynamic Bars”中绑定按键（每条 12 个按钮）。

English reference: The bar fades to the opacity on the right until the cursor is over it.
Simplified Chinese: 鼠标未悬停时，动作条淡出至右侧指定的不透明度。

English reference: Items always shown on this bar when they are in your bags, even if automatic detection misses them (sharpening stones...). Type an item ID or drag an item from your bags into the field.
Simplified Chinese: 只要背包中存在就始终显示在此动作条上的物品，即使自动检测遗漏（如磨刀石）。输入物品 ID，或将背包物品拖入输入框。

English reference: Click to remove from the whitelist
Simplified Chinese: 点击从强制显示列表移除

English reference: Moves the Horizon Suite quest panel beyond its usual limit (it normally stops at the screen edge). The shift is written into Horizon Suite's own saved position, so dragging the panel afterwards keeps it.
Simplified Chinese: 允许 Horizon Suite 任务面板超出通常的位置限制（一般止于屏幕边缘）。偏移会写入 Horizon Suite 自己保存的位置，之后拖动面板也会保留。
垂直偏移（像素，正数向上）

English reference: The colon between hours and minutes blinks every second.
Simplified Chinese: 时与分之间的冒号每秒闪烁。

English reference:
Left click: Calendar
Right click: Stopwatch
Simplified Chinese:
左键：日历
右键：秒表

English reference: Remove the shortcut "%s" from the Menu Bar?
Simplified Chinese: 从菜单栏移除快捷入口“%s”？

English reference: Removes the color of the icons so the icon color below applies to all of them.
Simplified Chinese: 去除图标原有颜色，让下方的图标颜色设置对全部图标生效。
松开以移除此快捷入口

English reference: Hides the default Blizzard menu bar while the Menu Bar is enabled.
Simplified Chinese: 启用此菜单栏时隐藏暴雪默认菜单栏。

English reference: Click a shortcut to change it  -  drag one onto another to swap them  -  + adds a shortcut
Simplified Chinese: 点击入口修改；拖到另一入口上交换；点击 + 添加入口

Shift+Ctrl+点击：钓鱼

Click: change the shortcut
Drag onto another: swap
Drag outside the bar: remove
Simplified Chinese:
点击：修改入口
拖到另一入口上：交换
拖到菜单栏外：移除

Simplified Chinese: 勾选：使用主题颜色模块中的“%s”颜色。取消勾选：使用本行选择的颜色。

Simplified Chinese: 剩余时间少于此值时提醒（分钟）

Simplified Chinese: 此技能无法添加到技能循环条。

Cannot delete the active profile

无法删除当前配置

Simplified Chinese: 此字符串来自较新的 AishCore 版本（%s），部分设置可能被忽略。

English reference: The checked modules will replace those of profile %s.
Simplified Chinese: 勾选的模块将覆盖配置 %s 中的对应模块。
由版本 %s 于 %s 导出。

星期 日 月（星期五 28 八月）

AishUI is a solo project I've been developing for 4 years now, with a simple goal: offer a more immersive, polished and cinematic experience, without sacrificing performance or usability.

The arrival of Midnight made maintaining the project particularly demanding. Keeping AishUI evolving today takes a huge amount of time: maintaining what already exists, rebuilding what got broken, developing new features, configuring the pack's addons and evolving the whole set of tools that make up AishUI.

Simplified Chinese: 在小地图上以图标显示草药和矿物

English reference: Replaces the minimap dots of Find Herbs / Find Minerals with the picture of each plant or ore vein. Needs one of those trackings to be on. Names are read from the minimap tooltip in your game language; a node that isn't recognised gets the tracking's generic icon.
Simplified Chinese: 将寻找草药／矿物的小地图圆点替换为对应植物或矿脉的图片，需要启用相应追踪。名称从游戏语言的小地图提示读取；无法识别的节点使用该追踪的通用图标。

English reference: Herbs and ore on the minimap
Not available on this client: it lacks the minimap calls this needs (%s).
Simplified Chinese: 当前客户端不支持：缺少所需的小地图接口（%s）。

English reference: Enjoy the fully theme-sorted model library %s!
Simplified Chinese: %s，即可使用按主题完整整理的模型库！

English reference: Enables AishCore's custom aura tracking system (icons, bars, circles...). Automatically disables Blizzard's native CDM, and vice versa.
Simplified Chinese: 启用 AishCore 自定义光环追踪系统（图标、进度条、圆环等）。会自动关闭暴雪原生冷却管理器，反之亦然。

English reference: Enlarges the mouse cursor during combat (easier to spot in the heat of the action), normal size the rest of the time.
Simplified Chinese: 战斗中放大鼠标指针，便于在激烈战斗中找到；其余时间恢复正常大小。

English reference:
Disables every module in this category and collapses the block.
Re-enabling restores each module's individual state.
Simplified Chinese:
禁用此类别中的所有模块并折叠分区。
重新启用后恢复各模块原来的开关状态。

English reference: Automatically adjusts the opacity of the player buffs frame (ElvUI or EllesmereUI) based on combat state.
Simplified Chinese: 根据战斗状态自动调整玩家增益框架（ElvUI 或 EllesmereUI）的不透明度。

English reference: 3D orb decorations around the resource circle (combo points, runes, essence…), independent from spell impact animations.
Simplified Chinese: 资源圆环周围的 3D 球体装饰（连击点、符文、精华等），独立于技能命中特效。

English reference: A small dot with two bars on each side that drain toward it for the duration of a speed buff (Sprint, Dash, Angelic Feather...). One row per active buff. Hidden while mounted, in a vehicle or in a pet battle.
Simplified Chinese: 小圆点两侧各有两条进度条，在加速增益（疾跑、急奔、天堂之羽等）持续期间朝圆点耗尽。每个生效增益一行。骑乘、载具或宠物对战中隐藏。

English reference: Themed Colors of your specialization: the dot uses "Power Dots B", the bars "Power Circle".
Simplified Chinese: 使用当前专精主题色：圆点使用“资源点 B”，进度条使用“资源圆环”。

English reference: The bars grow with the number of stacks (30 max) instead of draining over the duration.
Simplified Chinese: 进度条随层数增长（最多 30 层），而非随持续时间耗尽。

English reference: Shows your resource (mana/energy/etc.) out of combat, next to the health circle.
Simplified Chinese: 脱战时在生命圆环旁显示法力、能量等资源。

English reference:
Shows Essence orbs around the small out-of-combat circle
in Devastation and Augmentation spec.
Simplified Chinese: 湮灭与增辉专精在脱战小圆环周围显示精华球。

English reference:
Shows a glowing halo behind the small resource circle,
colored according to the active specialization.
Simplified Chinese:
在小资源圆环后显示发光光晕，
按当前专精着色。

English reference:
Shows Holy Power orbs around the small out-of-combat circle
in Protection and Retribution spec.
Simplified Chinese: 防护与惩戒专精在脱战小圆环周围显示圣能球。

English reference: Shows the circle only when the resource changes (default behavior).
Simplified Chinese: 仅资源变化时显示圆环（默认行为）。

English reference: Circle disabled: settings unavailable. Tick its toggle at the top of this page to configure it.
Simplified Chinese: 圆环已禁用，无法设置。请勾选页面顶部开关后配置。

English reference:
Reverses the orbs' appearance order:
by default right→left, checked left→right.
Simplified Chinese:
反转球体的出现顺序：
默认从右向左，勾选后从左向右。
|cff00b0ff[AishCore]|r 面板已因进入战斗而自动关闭。

English reference: Paste the profile string here (click in the black area then Ctrl+V):
Simplified Chinese: 在此粘贴配置字符串（点击黑色区域后按 Ctrl+V）：

English reference: Desaturates the icon when the spell cannot be cast: not enough resources, cooldown running, or no charge left. The global cooldown is ignored.
Simplified Chinese: 技能因资源不足、正在冷却或没有剩余充能而无法施放时，将图标去色。忽略公共冷却。

English reference: Shows 4 spell icons on either side of the circle in combat.
Simplified Chinese: 战斗中在圆环两侧显示 4 个技能图标。

English reference:
Hides icons for spells that are not known
(wrong talent, wrong level, wrong spec).
Simplified Chinese:
隐藏尚未学会的技能图标
（天赋、等级或专精不符）。

English reference:
Left-click: set a specific glow color
for this spell.
Simplified Chinese:
左键：为此技能设置
独立发光颜色。

右键：重置为
全局颜色。
忽略暴雪技能循环助手

English reference: The bar no longer follows the spell suggested by Blizzard's Rotation Assistant: slots keep their default spell.
Simplified Chinese: 提示条不再跟随暴雪技能循环助手建议的技能，各栏位保留默认技能。

English reference: Uses the active spec's "Power Circle" color from Themed Colors instead of the color chosen above.
Simplified Chinese: 使用主题颜色中当前专精的“资源圆环”颜色，而非上方选择的颜色。

English reference: Tints the icon when the current target is out of range for that spell, the same way the Essential and Utility cooldown viewers do. Spells that need no target are never tinted.
Simplified Chinese: 当前目标超出技能距离时，将图标着色，行为与核心／功能冷却视图一致。无需目标的技能不会着色。

English reference: Highlights the icon when Blizzard makes this spell glow on your action bars (e.g. a buff that enhances it). Does not include Rotation Assistant suggestions.
Simplified Chinese: 暴雪让动作条上的技能发光时（例如增益强化该技能），高亮此图标。不包含技能循环助手的建议。

English reference: Only shows the proc highlight in Healer or Tank specializations.
Simplified Chinese: 只在治疗或坦克专精中显示触发高亮。

English reference: Animates a circular arc on the icon while the spell is on cooldown.
Simplified Chinese: 技能冷却时在图标上显示环形扫光。

English reference: Aura tooltip in combat only with ALT
Simplified Chinese: 战斗中仅按住 ALT 显示光环提示

English reference:
Controls the buff/debuff icon tooltip (Auras module).
In combat, the tooltip only appears while holding ALT.
Outside combat, it always shows on hover.
Simplified Chinese:
控制光环模块的增益／减益图标提示。
战斗中仅按住 ALT 才显示；
脱战时悬停即显示。

English reference: The glow uses the 'Glow' color defined in the Colors module for your active spec.
Simplified Chinese: 发光使用颜色模块中当前专精的“发光”颜色。

English reference: Shows the bar only in combat (default behavior).
Simplified Chinese: 仅战斗中显示提示条（默认行为）。

English reference: Shows the bar while the target is attackable. In combat it stays visible even with no target; on a healing spec it stays visible out of combat whatever the target.
Simplified Chinese: 目标可攻击时显示提示条；战斗中没有目标也保持显示。治疗专精在脱战时不受目标条件限制。
|cff00b0ff[AishCore Profiles]|r 已导入配置 %s，正在切换……

English reference: |cff00b0ff[AishCore Profiles]|r Select a profile to delete.
Simplified Chinese: |cff00b0ff[AishCore Profiles]|r 请选择要删除的配置。

English reference: Use this profile for all characters

Checked: the active profile applies to all your characters.
Unchecked: this profile is bound only to the current character.
Simplified Chinese:
勾选：所有角色使用当前配置。
取消勾选：此配置仅绑定当前角色。
缺失提醒 - 背包已满
缺失提醒 - 传承点数
缺失提醒 - 磨刀石／武器油
缺失提醒 - 天赋点数
缺失提醒 - 草药追踪未开启
缺失提醒 - 矿物追踪未开启

English reference: Drag the circle — click to finish
Frames the central circle with a dragon when the target is elite (outside instances only), rare, rare elite or a world boss.
Simplified Chinese: 目标为精英（仅副本外）、稀有、稀有精英或世界首领时，在中央圆环周围显示龙形装饰。

English reference:
Shows a mana/resource circle at the center of the screen
in combat or when a target is selected.
Simplified Chinese: 在战斗中或选中目标时，在屏幕中央显示法力／资源圆环。

English reference:
Shows Essence orbs around the resource circle
in Devastation and Augmentation spec (in addition to the arc).
Simplified Chinese:
湮灭与增辉专精除圆弧外，
还在资源圆环周围显示精华球。

English reference:
Shows a glowing halo behind the resource circle,
colored according to the active specialization.
Simplified Chinese:
在资源圆环后显示发光光晕，
按当前专精着色。

English reference:
Shows Holy Power orbs around the resource circle
in Protection and Retribution spec (in addition to the arc).
Simplified Chinese:
防护与惩戒专精除圆弧外，
还在资源圆环周围显示圣能球。

English reference: Switches between the vertical fill (default) and a radial gauge-arc fill.
Simplified Chinese: 在垂直填充（默认）和径向仪表圆弧填充之间切换。

English reference: Checked: the arc and the resource text use the colors of the Themed Colors module. Unchecked: pick the arc color and the main resource text color on this line.
Simplified Chinese: 勾选：圆弧和资源文字使用主题颜色模块。取消勾选：使用本行选择的圆弧颜色和主资源文字颜色。

English reference: Shows the circle at all times (even out of combat).
Simplified Chinese: 始终显示圆环，包括脱战状态。

English reference: Shows the circle only in combat (default behavior).
Simplified Chinese: 仅在战斗中显示圆环（默认行为）。

English reference: Shows the circle while the target is attackable. In combat it stays visible even with no target; on a healing spec it stays visible out of combat whatever the target.
Simplified Chinese: 存在可攻击目标时显示；战斗中即使没有目标也保持显示。治疗专精在脱战时不受目标条件限制。

English reference: Drag to reposition — click to finish
Simplified Chinese: 拖动重新定位，点击结束
启用技能轮换按钮模块

English reference: Shows a mirrored icon of the spell currently highlighted by Blizzard's Assisted Combat rotation helper.
Simplified Chinese: 镜像显示暴雪辅助战斗循环助手当前高亮的技能图标。

English reference: Hides the icon in rest areas (city, inn...), unless an attackable target is selected (training dummy, stray enemy...).
Simplified Chinese: 在城市、旅店等休息区域隐藏图标，但选中了可攻击目标（训练假人、游荡敌人等）时仍会显示。

English reference: Shows the icon as soon as a spell is highlighted, even out of combat.
Simplified Chinese: 一旦有技能被高亮就显示图标，包括脱战时。

English reference: Shows the icon only in combat (default behavior).
Simplified Chinese: 仅战斗中显示图标（默认行为）。

English reference: Shows the icon while the target is attackable. In combat it stays visible even with no target; on a healing spec it stays visible out of combat whatever the target.
Simplified Chinese: 目标可攻击时显示图标；战斗中没有目标也保持显示。治疗专精在脱战时不受目标条件限制。

English reference:
Shows the absorb amount abbreviated (ex: 10000 -> 10k)
instead of the raw number.
Simplified Chinese:
以缩写显示吸收量（例如 10000 → 10k），
而非完整数字。

English reference: Two mirrored half-bars under the secondary resource text: they drain toward the centre, giving the illusion of a single bar shrinking from both ends.
Simplified Chinese: 在次要资源文字下显示两条镜像半条：向中心消退，呈现整条从两端向内缩短的效果。
按栏位设置技能（当前专精）
玩家增益区域不透明度

English reference: Turns off all 3D animations whenever you are in a group (non-raid).
Simplified Chinese: 在小队中（非团队）关闭所有 3D 动画。

English reference: Turns off all 3D animations whenever you are in a raid group.
Simplified Chinese: 在团队中关闭所有 3D 动画。

English reference: Triggers 3D effects around the resource circle when casting.
Simplified Chinese: 施法时在资源圆环周围触发 3D 特效。

English reference: Displays the key bound to the spell shown on the icon, when that spell is found on one of your action bars (Blizzard bars or ElvUI).
Simplified Chinese: 若图标中的技能位于任一动作条（暴雪动作条或 ElvUI），显示该技能绑定的快捷键。

English reference: Assigns a different profile to each specialization. The profile switches automatically when you change spec.
Simplified Chinese: 为不同专精指定配置，切换专精时自动切换。

English reference: Automatically switches profile based on your active specialization.
Simplified Chinese: 根据当前专精自动切换配置方案。

English reference: Unlock hundreds of finely animated spells and auras %s!
Simplified Chinese: 解锁数百种精美的技能与光环动画 %s！

English reference: Uses the two colors defined below.
Simplified Chinese: 使用下方设定的两种颜色。

English reference:
Gradient extracted from the cast bar at takeoff:
first color = without buff, second = with buff + boost.
Simplified Chinese:
从起飞时的施法条提取渐变色：
第一种颜色＝无增益，第二种＝有增益并加速。

English reference:
Without buff: the spec's Power Text color.
With buff + boost: the spec's Power Circle color.
Simplified Chinese:
无增益：使用该专精的资源文字颜色。
有增益并加速：使用该专精的资源圆环颜色。

English reference: Drag the ring — click to finish
Drag the ring with left-click, click again to finish.
Simplified Chinese: 左键拖动圆环，再次点击完成。

English reference:
Shows the vigor orbs, speed ring,
and visual effects while Skyriding.
Simplified Chinese:
驭空飞行时显示精力球、速度圆环
和视觉特效。

English reference:
Hides the health circle (visible when taking damage)
while Skyriding.
Simplified Chinese:
驭空飞行时隐藏生命圆环
（通常在受到伤害时显示）。

English reference:
Hides the out-of-combat resource circle
while Skyriding.
Simplified Chinese: 驭空飞行时隐藏脱战资源圆环。

English reference:
Automatically hides the Skyriding HUD when
speed is zero (on the ground / stopped).
Simplified Chinese:
速度为零时（在地面／停止移动）
自动隐藏驭空术界面。

English reference:
Hides the 4 Priority Bar slots
while Skyriding.
Simplified Chinese: 驭空飞行时隐藏优先技能条的 4 个栏位。

English reference:
Hides the main resource circle
while Skyriding.
Simplified Chinese: 驭空飞行时隐藏主资源圆环。

English reference:
Hides the Rotation Button Module's icons
during Skyriding or while flying on a flying mount.
Simplified Chinese:
驭空飞行或乘飞行坐骑飞行时，
隐藏输出循环按钮模块的图标。

English reference:
Hides the player, target, focus, and pet bars
while Skyriding.
Simplified Chinese: 驭空飞行时隐藏玩家、目标、焦点和宠物条。

English reference:
Shows the stagger percentage under the central circle's resource text,
in the same spot as the Stage Fright stacks.
Simplified Chinese:
在中央圆环资源文字下方显示醉拳百分比，
与怯场层数位于同一位置。

English reference: Darkens the screen with a vignette while you are stealthed (Stealth, Vanish, Shadow Dance, Subterfuge, Prowl...). The vignette stretches to the whole screen, ultrawide included.
Simplified Chinese: 潜行时（潜行、消失、暗影之舞、诡诈、潜伏等）以暗角压暗屏幕。暗角覆盖整个屏幕，兼容超宽屏。
羽化（1 柔和－5 锐利）

English reference: The screen is never darkened while you are in combat (stealth abilities usable in combat, such as Shadow Dance, included).
Simplified Chinese: 战斗中始终不压暗屏幕，包括暗影之舞等可在战斗中使用的潜行技能。

English reference: Replaces the arc with a bar. The arc settings are grayed out and the bar settings become available.
Simplified Chinese: 将弧形条替换为直条。弧形设置变灰，条形设置变为可用。

English reference: Radial arc that empties between two auto attacks (melee, Auto Shot, wand). Forever only.
Simplified Chinese: 在两次自动攻击之间逐渐清空的弧形条（近战、自动射击、魔杖）。仅限无限服。

English reference: Checked: the arc or bar fills during the delay instead of emptying.
Simplified Chinese: 勾选后，弧形条或直条在攻击间隔内逐渐填满，而非清空。

English reference: When dual wielding, only the main-hand auto attack is tracked.
Simplified Chinese: 双持时仅追踪主手自动攻击。

English reference: No arc or bar for melee swings: only ranged attacks are tracked.
Simplified Chinese: 不显示近战攻击的弧形条或直条，仅追踪远程攻击。

English reference: Shows the target's buffs and debuffs under Top Target.
Simplified Chinese: 在顶部目标条下方显示目标的增益与减益。

English reference: New rows are added upward instead of downward.
Simplified Chinese: 新增行向上排列，而非向下。

English reference: Only shows debuffs applied by the player.
Simplified Chinese: 仅显示玩家施加的减益。

English reference: Reverses the direction of the cooldown swipe.
Enables or disables the border around the icons.
Enables the cooldown swipe on the icons.
Simplified Chinese: 启用图标上的冷却扫光。

English reference: Drag the bar — click to finish
Shows a bar while the target is casting.
Simplified Chinese: 目标施法时显示进度条。

English reference: Shows the spell icon to the left of the bar.
Simplified Chinese: 在进度条左侧显示技能图标。

English reference: Adds an ornament in the middle of the bottom of Top Target: silver for rares and rare elites, gold for elites and world bosses.
Simplified Chinese: 在顶部目标条底部中央添加装饰：稀有和稀有精英为银色，精英与世界首领为金色。

English reference: Shows the target and target-of-target bar at the top of the screen.
Simplified Chinese: 在屏幕顶部显示目标及目标的目标条。

English reference: Shows the target's energy/mana/rage bar under the health bar (same style, colored by power type).
Simplified Chinese: 在生命条下方显示目标的能量／法力／怒气条（样式相同，按资源类型着色）。

English reference: Shows a small health bar for your target's target under Top Target.
Simplified Chinese: 在顶部目标条下方显示目标的目标的小型生命条。

English reference: Select a profile to activate it.
Click: turn on / off. Drag: move. Shift during the conversation: no auto turn-in.
Simplified Chinese: 点击：开关。拖动：移动。对话时按住 Shift：暂停自动交任务。

English reference: On: completed quests are turned in automatically
Simplified Chinese: 开启：自动提交已完成的任务

English reference: Color of the shield (absorb) bar. Click to choose.
Simplified Chinese: 护盾（吸收）条的颜色。点击选择。

English reference:
By default the absorb shows on the right of the HP fill.
Mirrored, it shows on the left, overlapping the start of the bar.
Simplified Chinese:
默认在生命填充右侧显示吸收量。
镜像后显示在左侧，与进度条起点重叠。

English reference: Color of the health bars (fill, dots, texts) when Themed Colors is unchecked.
Simplified Chinese: 未勾选主题配色时，生命条的颜色（填充、圆点与文字）。

English reference: Bar disabled: settings unavailable. Tick it under "Bars shown" (or on the Modules page) to configure it.
Simplified Chinese: 该条已禁用，设置不可用。在“显示的条”（或模块页）中勾选后即可配置。

English reference: Color of everything shown in black on the bars (background, outline, third dot, inverted fill) when Themed Colors is unchecked.
Simplified Chinese: 未勾选主题配色时，条上所有黑色部分的颜色（背景、轮廓、第三个圆点与反向填充）。

English reference: Inverted colors (colored background and black health)
Simplified Chinese: 反转颜色（彩色背景、黑色生命填充）

English reference: Colored background and black fill. Unchecked: colored fill and black background.
Simplified Chinese: 彩色背景与黑色填充。未勾选时使用彩色填充与黑色背景。

English reference: Shows health bars for the player, target, focus, pet, and target of target.
Simplified Chinese: 显示玩家、目标、焦点、宠物及目标的目标的生命条。

English reference: Color of the incoming heals segment. Click to choose.
Simplified Chinese: 即将生效的治疗段颜色。点击选择。

English reference: Adds the heals already on their way to the right of the health fill, before the shield bar.
Simplified Chinese: 在生命填充右侧、护盾条之前显示即将生效的治疗量。

English reference: Grows the hover and click area by this many pixels on every side, without changing how the bar looks. Only counts while "On hover" is ticked, and drops back to zero in combat, where an oversized hitbox would make you miss whatever sits around the bar. Moving the slider outlines the area on screen for a few seconds.
Simplified Chinese: 向四周扩展指定像素的悬停与点击区域，不改变外观。仅在勾选“鼠标悬停时”后生效；战斗中归零，避免扩大的点击区域挡住周围元素。拖动滑块时会短暂显示区域轮廓。

English reference: While the cursor is on a bar, its health text switches to the raw value even when the percentage mode is selected. Uses the same hover tolerance as the visibility section.
Simplified Chinese: 鼠标悬停于条上时，即使选择了百分比模式，也改为显示实际生命值。使用与显示条件设置相同的悬停容差。

English reference: Shows a whole number from 0 to 100 indicating the health percentage.
Simplified Chinese: 显示 0 到 100 的整数，表示生命百分比。

English reference: Shows the abbreviated raw health value.
Simplified Chinese: 显示缩写后的实际生命值。

English reference: Prevents the bars from being moved by drag-and-drop.
Show your character's name when hovering your health bar
Simplified Chinese: 鼠标悬停生命条时显示角色名称

English reference: Shows your character's name above your health bar while the cursor is on it (tolerance zone included). Out of combat only.
Simplified Chinese: 鼠标位于自身生命条（含容差区域）上时，在条上方显示角色名称。仅限脱战状态。

English reference: No specialization of your class has this role.
Simplified Chinese: 你的职业没有担任此职责的专精。

English reference: Different display rules depending on the role of your active specialization: DPS, Healer or Tank. In combat, the frames are always shown.
Simplified Chinese: 按当前专精职责（输出、治疗或坦克）使用不同显示规则。战斗中始终显示框架。
显示装饰圆点（3 个小圆）

English reference: Shows or hides the 3 decorative circles on the side of the health bars.
Simplified Chinese: 显示或隐藏生命条旁的 3 个装饰圆点。

English reference:
Shows the absorbed amount (shields) in blue on the health bars.
The blue area appears right after the health fill.
Simplified Chinese:
在生命条上以蓝色显示吸收量（护盾）。
蓝色区域紧接在生命填充之后。
坦克专精使用更高的条

English reference: Uses a larger height for player, target, and focus in tank specs.
Simplified Chinese: 坦克专精时，增大玩家、目标和焦点条的高度。

English reference: Show the level on the target bar

Shows the level before the target's name, like the Top Target Bar (e.g. "7 • Name"). The level is colored by difficulty: grey (trivial), green (easy), yellow (even), orange (hard), red (elite / much higher level).
Simplified Chinese: 在目标名称前显示等级，与顶部目标条相同（例如“7 • 名称”）。等级按难度着色：灰色（过低）、绿色（简单）、黄色（相当）、橙色（困难）、红色（精英／等级远高于你）。

English reference: Checked: the bars use the colors of the Themed Colors module (class, pet...). Unchecked: pick your own bar color and background color on this line.
Simplified Chinese: 勾选：使用主题配色模块的颜色（职业、宠物等）。取消勾选：在本行自行选择条颜色和背景色。

English reference: Adds to the mode above rather than replacing it: moving the cursor onto a bar brings it out, even when the current mode keeps it hidden. Handy for reaching a bar that is hidden out of combat. This is also the switch that turns the tolerance below on. A bar whose unit does not exist stays hidden.
Simplified Chinese: 在上述模式基础上追加条件：鼠标移到条上时，即使当前模式将其隐藏也会显示，便于找到脱战时隐藏的条。此选项同时启用下方容差设置。对应单位不存在时仍保持隐藏。

English reference: Shows the frames at all times: the other conditions then have no effect, except the two "Hide" ones.
Simplified Chinese: 始终显示框架；除两个“隐藏”条件外，其他条件不再生效。

English reference: Hides the frames in this case, even with "Always". Hovering still shows them, and in combat they are still shown.
Simplified Chinese: 符合此条件时隐藏框架，即使选择了“始终显示”。鼠标悬停仍可显示，战斗中也仍然显示。

English reference: Uses a color from the Colors module (chosen alongside) for the current specialization, instead of the color configured here.
Simplified Chinese: 使用配色模块中为当前专精选择的颜色（在旁边选择），替代此处设置的颜色。
副本中始终显示（地下城／团队副本）

English reference: While you're in a dungeon or raid, this module stays shown continuously -- it no longer hides when you leave combat. Outside an instance, the visibility mode above takes over normally.
Simplified Chinese: 在地下城或团队副本内持续显示此模块，不因脱战而隐藏。离开副本后，恢复使用上方的显示条件。

English reference:
Automatically adjusts the opacity of your UI's player buffs frame based on combat state.
Works with ElvUI and EllesmereUI; no effect if neither is installed.
Simplified Chinese:
根据战斗状态自动调整玩家增益框架的不透明度。
支持 ElvUI 与 EllesmereUI；两者均未安装时不生效。

English reference: While hovering the buffs zone, temporarily show it at full opacity, regardless of combat state.
Simplified Chinese: 鼠标悬停增益区域时，临时以完全不透明显示，不受战斗状态影响。

English reference: Shows a circle while you eat: it empties over the eating time and changes color when you get the Well Fed buff (about halfway).
Simplified Chinese: 进食时显示圆环：随进食时间逐渐清空，在获得进食充分增益时（约进食到一半）变色。

English reference: A round icon of the food you are eating, in the middle of the circle.
Simplified Chinese: 在圆环中央显示正在食用的食物圆形图标。

English reference: Reset the Well Fed circle position
Simplified Chinese: 重置进食充分圆环位置

English reference: Show the circle even if the food gives no buff
Simplified Chinese: 无增益的食物也显示圆环

English reference: The circle also appears for food that will not give Well Fed. It empties normally but never turns to the Well Fed color.
Simplified Chinese: 食物不会提供进食充分增益时也显示圆环。圆环正常清空，但不会变为进食充分颜色。

English reference: When you get the Well Fed buff, a "+" and the buff icon rise above the circle.
Simplified Chinese: 获得进食充分增益时，“+”与增益图标从圆环上方浮起。

English reference: Reads the food tooltip (e.g. +59 Versatility) and shows it to the right of the icon, when the stats can be found.
Simplified Chinese: 读取食物提示（例如 +59 全能）；能识别属性时，将其显示在图标右侧。

English reference: Shows short names (Haste, Mast, Vers, AP, SP...) instead of the full stat names.
Simplified Chinese: 使用属性简称（急速、精通、全能、攻强、法强等），替代完整名称。

English reference:
Custom UI overlay — resource & health circles, spell effects,
priority bar, unit bars, XP bar…

AishCore has a full floating configuration panel.
Click the button below or use |cff00b0ff/aish|r to open it.
Simplified Chinese:
自定义界面——资源与生命圆环、技能特效、
优先技能条、单位条、经验条等。

AishCore 提供完整的浮动设置面板。
点击下方按钮或输入 |cff00b0ff/aish|r 打开。

English reference: Keeps the experience bar on screen at all times. The detailed figures (total, tooltip) still only appear on mouseover.
Simplified Chinese: 始终在屏幕上显示经验条。详细数值（总量、提示）仍仅在鼠标悬停时显示。

English reference:
In a delve, shows the companion's XP
instead of reputation.
Takes priority over reputation, delves only.
Simplified Chinese:
在地下堡中以伙伴经验替代声望显示。
优先于声望，仅在地下堡中生效。

English reference:
Shows an XP bar at the bottom when you gain experience (4s)
or when hovering the bottom-left corner.
Automatically hidden at max level.
Simplified Chinese:
获得经验时显示底部经验条（4 秒），
或鼠标悬停左下角时显示。
满级后自动隐藏。

English reference:
Shows the reputation that most recently progressed,
until the next reputation gain.
Simplified Chinese:
显示最近提升的声望，
直到下一次声望获得。

English reference:
Always shows the reputation currently
tracked in the Reputation panel.
Simplified Chinese:
始终显示声望面板中
当前追踪的声望。

English reference: At max level, replaces the XP bar with reputation.
Simplified Chinese: 满级后以声望条替代经验条。

English reference:
Shows a 3D animation (in-game model) when the player
is in a rested area (inn, capital city).
Simplified Chinese:
玩家位于休息区域（旅店、主城）时，
显示 3D 动画（游戏内模型）。

English reference:
Forces the indicator to display so you can position it,
even if you're not in a rested area.
Simplified Chinese:
强制显示指示器以调整位置，
即使当前不在休息区域。

English reference: %s is not installed: nothing to switch to.

Switch this character from %s to %s?
The game will reload.
Simplified Chinese:
将此角色从 %s 切换至 %s？
游戏界面将重载。

English reference:
Switch this character to %s?
The game will reload.
Simplified Chinese:
将此角色切换至 %s？
游戏界面将重载。

English reference: X / Y: offset from screen center.
Simplified Chinese: X / Y：相对于屏幕中心的偏移。

English reference: Open your class trainer once: upcoming spells will be recorded
Simplified Chinese: 访问一次职业训练师，即可记录即将可学的技能

English reference: When hovering the level, shows in the bottom right of the screen what the next level unlocks: (estimated) gains and new spells.
Simplified Chinese: 鼠标悬停等级时，在屏幕右下方显示下一级解锁的内容：预计属性提升与新技能。

English reference: [ALT] : Quests to turn in   [SHIFT] : Skills to train
[ALT]: Quests to turn in   [SHIFT]: Quests in progress
When you level up, shows the level reached, the stats gained and the new spells.
Simplified Chinese: 升级时显示新等级、获得的属性与新技能。

English reference: A level gained in combat keeps its toast until combat ends.
Simplified Chinese: 在战斗中升级时，延后至战斗结束再显示升级提示。
